Ij.name: LobbyEncounter
Ij.evidence: its kind is "lobby" and the registry's lobby entry constructs it (factory: () => new Ij())

Cj.name: lobbyCenterX
Cj.evidence: inferred: subtracted from x + 0.5 before the distance test that makes the walkable disc; the 8 ring obstacles are placed around it

xj.name: lobbyCenterY
xj.evidence: inferred: the y counterpart of lobbyCenterX

Bj.name: lobbyRadius
Bj.evidence: inferred: a tile is walkable when its centre is at most this far from the centre

Wj.name: lobbyGridSize
Wj.evidence: returned as sizeX and sizeY of the collision map; the flags array has 4096 = 64 * 64 entries

Rj.name: lobbyArenaCache
Rj.evidence: inferred: getArenaConfig returns it when set and otherwise stores the arena it builds in it
